title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the specific study nooks, quiet retreats, and social hubs that Colgate students use to navigate their daily academic life beyond the standard tour stops.

cards.title: The Level 5 Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Case Library and Geyer Center for Information Technology
cards.notes: Head to the fifth floor past the Chobani Cafe for a 24-hour quiet zone with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Payne Brook and the village.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour quiet study space on the top floor of Case Library featuring expansive views and a mix of large tables and comfortable lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Reading Room on level 5 of Case Library is open 24 hours and features large windows with views of Payne Brook.
cards.source_title: Top Five Best Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with keycard access after regular building hours.

cards.title: The Glass Bridge at Persson
cards.subtitle: Persson Hall
cards.notes: Study in the glass-enclosed lounge connecting the two wings of Persson Hall, offering views of Taylor Lake and the lower campus.
cards.short_summary: A scenic glass-walled bridge lounge that serves as a popular study spot and architectural connector between the upper and lower campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Persson Hall features a glass bridge on the second level with floor-to-ceiling windows and tables for individual and group work.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; features round tables and long work surfaces.

cards.title: Ho Science Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Robert H.N. Ho Science Center
cards.notes: Utilize the open atrium and small end-of-hallway study areas for collaborative work under high ceilings and natural light.
cards.short_summary: A bright, multi-level atrium in the science center known for its open floor plan and glass railings, popular for group projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ho Science Center offers public access study spaces in the atrium area and small end-of-hallway study areas.
cards.access_notes: Available when not in use for faculty or staff events; typically open during building hours.

cards.title: Chapel House Retreat
cards.subtitle: Chapel House
cards.notes: Visit this quiet retreat at the edge of the forest for silent study or meditation in the 24-hour Meditation Hall.
cards.short_summary: A secluded interfaith center offering a library of 4,000 books on spirituality, a music room, and a 24-hour meditation space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Meditation Hall at Chapel House is open 24 hours a day for use at any time for students and visitors.
cards.access_notes: The Meditation Hall is open 24/7; the library and music room have standard daytime hours.

cards.title: ALANA Center Lounge
cards.subtitle: ALANA Cultural Center
cards.notes: A welcoming community space for social gathering and group study, featuring a library and multicultural resources.
cards.short_summary: A hub for multicultural exploration and social justice education that provides a comfortable lounge for student gathering and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The ALANA Cultural Center lounge is available for group study and social gathering, with hours until 9 p.m. on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8 a.m. - 9 p.m. and Saturday-Sunday 4 p.m. - 9 p.m.

cards.title: Lathrop Hall Lobby
cards.subtitle: Lathrop Hall
cards.notes: The renovated lobby offers an open, inviting space for collaboration near the Writing and Speaking Center.
cards.short_summary: A modern, light-filled lobby in one of Colgate's oldest buildings, redesigned to facilitate student collaboration and informal study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lathrop Hall renovation created a transformed, wide-open lobby that allows for open collaboration and use of technology.
cards.source_title: Lathrop Hall, built in 1905, undergoes major makeover
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; located on the main floor.

cards.title: Cooley Science Library
cards.subtitle: McGregory Hall
cards.notes: Located in the middle of the academic quad, this library offers a quiet environment with carrels and desktop computers.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated science library in McGregory Hall known for its quiet atmosphere and convenient location for students between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Cooley Science Library in McGregory Hall features study tables, carrels, and is generally a quiet space for individual study.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 a.m. most nights; food is not permitted in this library.

cards.title: Casual Study at The Coop
cards.subtitle: O'Connor Campus Center
cards.notes: Join the 'Coop lock-in' for casual homework in a social environment with background noise and easy access to food.
cards.short_summary: The central student union hub where students often engage in 'casual homework' amidst the social buzz of the dining area.
cards.evidence_claim: Students use the O'Connor Campus Center (the Coop) for productive casual homework and 'Coop lock-ins'.
cards.source_title: The Coop: A Dining Room, a Computer Lab and a Place to Study
cards.access_notes: Open late; particularly busy during lunch hours but offers computer labs and lounges for study.

cards.title: Olin Hall Breakout Rooms
cards.subtitle: Olin Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the modern breakout rooms for collaborative group study sessions in a building known for its natural light.
cards.short_summary: Modern academic building featuring breakout rooms designed for group collaboration and peer-to-peer learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin Hall has breakout rooms that are useful for studying with a group of peers in a collaborative atmosphere.
cards.source_title: Top Five Best Study Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; popular for its modern facilities.

cards.title: Seven Oaks Clubhouse
cards.subtitle: Seven Oaks Golf Club
cards.notes: Walk down to the clubhouse for a meal with views of the course; a quiet alternative to campus dining halls.
cards.short_summary: The clubhouse of Colgate's award-winning golf course, offering a full restaurant and a relaxing space for students to gather.
cards.evidence_claim: The Seven Oaks Clubhouse features a full restaurant and is a place to relax with friends and enjoy views of the course.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public and students; walking is required for students on the course, but the clubhouse is accessible by road.
